Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Writing WRITING skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing WRITING skills. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.
